adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies that the test at line 40 only checks that the post content is updated ('post.cooked.should =~ /new contents/') but doesn't verify the content_sha1 mechanism that controls deduplication. Looking at the diff, TopicEmbed.import uses content_sha1 to determine whether to update (line 'if content_sha1 != embed.content_sha1'). The test doesn't verify: 1) that content_sha1 actually changes when content changes, 2) that importing identical content a second time skips revision. This is a legitimate test coverage gap for the deduplication logic introduced in this diff, though it's not a bug since the implementation appears correct - it's missing test coverage for an important edge case.
